repo.tests/test_visible.py:
from tickets import ROWS
from parsing import parse_tickets

LINES = ["%s,%s" % (k, v) for k, v in ROWS]


def test_all_lines():
    assert len(parse_tickets("\n".join(LINES))) == len(ROWS)


def test_trailing_newline():
    assert len(parse_tickets("\n".join(LINES) + "\n")) == len(ROWS)
